title: Evaluation Framework: The 4 Components
summary: Define success signals, analyze agent failures using logs and traces, classify root causes, and tune instructions, memory, and tool access based on evidence.

rows: Modified files, new PR, test report
What the agent must NOT do
Never modify config/, never push to main
Test pass rate, lint count, vuln count

blocks.text: **Metric Gaming:** An agent could maximize test count by writing trivial tests — satisfying the metric without delivering value. Criteria must reflect genuine team intent, not just what's easy to count.
